SELECT a.*, u.name AS employee_name, pe.user_id
FROM payroll_ausencias a
LEFT JOIN payroll_employees pe ON a.employee_id = pe.id
LEFT JOIN users u ON pe.user_id = u.id
WHERE (a.employee_id = $1::uuid OR pe.user_id = $1::uuid)
ORDER BY a.fecha_desde DESC

SELECT a.*, u.name AS employee_name, pe.user_id
FROM payroll_ausencias a
LEFT JOIN payroll_employees pe ON a.employee_id = pe.id
LEFT JOIN users u ON pe.user_id = u.id
WHERE ($1::integer IS NULL OR a.clinic_id = $1::integer)
  AND ($2::ausencia_tipo_enum IS NULL OR a.tipo = $2::ausencia_tipo_enum)
  AND ($3::ausencia_estado_enum IS NULL OR a.estado = $3::ausencia_estado_enum)
ORDER BY a.fecha_desde DESC

INSERT INTO payroll_ausencias
  (id, employee_id, clinic_id, tipo, fecha_desde, fecha_hasta, dias,
   justificada, pagada, estado, descripcion, documento_url, aprobado_por, created_by)
VALUES
  (COALESCE(NULLIF($1,'')::uuid, gen_random_uuid()),
   $2::uuid,
   NULLIF($3,'')::integer,
   $4::ausencia_tipo_enum,
   $5::date, $6::date,
   NULLIF($7,'')::decimal,
   $8::boolean, $9::boolean,
   $10::ausencia_estado_enum,
   NULLIF($11,''), NULLIF($12,''), NULLIF($13,''),
   NULLIF($14,'')::uuid)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  tipo          = EXCLUDED.tipo,
  fecha_desde   = EXCLUDED.fecha_desde,
  fecha_hasta   = EXCLUDED.fecha_hasta,
  dias          = EXCLUDED.dias,
  justificada   = EXCLUDED.justificada,
  pagada        = EXCLUDED.pagada,
  estado        = EXCLUDED.estado,
  descripcion   = EXCLUDED.descripcion,
  documento_url = EXCLUDED.documento_url,
  aprobado_por  = EXCLUDED.aprobado_por
RETURNING *
DELETE FROM payroll_ausencias WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id

WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT setting_value::numeric FROM payroll_settings WHERE setting_key='vacation_days_per_year'), 20) AS base
)
SELECT
  FLOOR((CURRENT_DATE - e.fecha_ingreso)/365.25)::int AS antiguedad_anios,
  ROUND(
    ((SELECT base FROM cfg) + FLOOR(FLOOR((CURRENT_DATE - e.fecha_ingreso)/365.25)/4.0))
    * GREATEST((CURRENT_DATE - e.fecha_ingreso)/365.25, 0), 2) AS generados,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.dias) FROM payroll_ausencias a
            WHERE a.employee_id = e.id AND a.tipo='vacaciones' AND a.estado='aprobada'), 0) AS tomados
FROM payroll_employees e
WHERE e.id = $1::uuid
